messages:
incident-bot: Pager — P1: KV/prefix cache hit-rate collapse observed for tenant 'macrobank' in prod-vpc-eu-west-1 (dedicated pool: pool-9). Auto-alert at 2026-03-15T03:20:00Z (ts 1924509999). Investigate.
irene_oncall: I'm on it. What's the customer impact? Any 5xx errors? :eyes:
mohit_sre: Looking at dashboards — prefix hit-rate dropped from 0.78 -> 0.02 around 03:19 UTC. Token costs spiked, tail latency up ~180ms. No large 5xx spike yet but elevated retries on client side. Traffic to pool-9 up ~1.6x in the last 5m, unique prefix cardinality jumped 30x.
carla_prodeng: suspecting cache pollution — a flood of unique prefixes from MacroBank's batch ingestion. If we leave per-tenant cache enabled, nodes thrash. We should disable prefix-level caching for the tenant temporarily and bump KV TTL to avoid churn.
mohit_sre: Agreed. I'll prepare the mitigation. Calling it out: impact is customer-specific (MacroBank), other tenants on pool-9 are degraded due to noisy neighbor. Need quick containment then a safer rollback.
sam_support: I'll open a brief PM to the MacroBank CSM and let them know we're performing a targeted mitigation. ETA on fix?
mohit_sre: Running disable command now:
```
# disable per-tenant prefix caching (mitigation)
redwoodctl cache tenant-config update --tenant macrobank --enable-prefix-cache false --ttl 3600 --reason "prefix-flood mitigation"
```
mohit_sre: Command output: "Applied tenant cache config for macrobank: enable-prefix-cache=false, ttl=3600" — deploying to pool-9 nodes. Applying to all cache frontends in the tenant ring.
deploy-bot: rollout started: tenant-config/macrobank:update -> 6 nodes. 223/6? (just kidding) :robot_face: 
carla_prodeng: Also set prefetch cap to 2 and enable conservative batching for this tenant to limit downstream pressure.
mohit_sre: Doing that too:
```
redwoodctl cache tenant-config update --tenant macrobank --prefetch-max 2 --batching-mode conservative
```
mohit_sre: Prefetch cap applied. Restarting cache workers on pool-9 in a rolling fashion to clear eviction storms (1 node at a time).
irene_oncall: Any quick verification checks we can run? I'll watch hit-rate and tail-latency dashboards.
mohit_sre: Post-mitigation numbers (next 3m): prefix hit-rate climbed to 0.45, overall token latency down ~90ms, retries back to baseline. CPU on cache frontends normalized. No further 5xx spikes.
sam_support: Notifying MacroBank: "We've applied a targeted change to your tenant cache to stabilize performance. Expect transient increase in token usage and slight latency bump; we're monitoring. Will follow up with RCA." :email: 
carla_prodeng: Recording temporary mitigation in casebook. We need a longer-term plan: enforce client-side prefix bucketing, or per-tenant admission control, and a quota on unique prefix openings.
mohit_sre: Agreed. Temporary mitigation notes added. Will capture exact affected prefix patterns and sample keys for postmortem.
ben_night: I'm taking over for the rest of the shift. Summary pls and any in-progress ops I need to continue?
irene_oncall: Summary: P1 due to MacroBank prefix flood causing cache pollution on pool-9 -> disabled per-tenant prefix cache + prefetch cap + rolling cache worker restarts. System stabilized. Monitor for 60m, then consider re-enabling with stricter limits.
ben_night: Got it. I'll keep monitoring dashboards and coordinate with CS for the customer reply. Please assign postmortem to mohit & carla and tag me.
mohit_sre: Will prepare timeline and attach sample keys, plus config diffs. Assigning postmortem: mohit_sre, carla_prodeng, ben_night.
incident-bot: Incident P1 (1924509999) acknowledged and escalated. Handoff complete at ts 1924511400.
sam_support: Adding note to MacroBank ticket: #MB-4217 — mitigation applied, monitoring, postmortem to follow.
carla_prodeng: Also raising an engineering task to add an automatic detection rule for sudden unique-prefix-cardinality increases per tenant.
ben_night: I'll follow up if anything regresses. thumbs up :thumbsup:
